verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a product-data API, but the evidence documents no batch endpoint or multi-item operation. Each documented capability, such as single-URL lookup or per-query search, handles one request at a time. Scriptable CLI calls and async SDK calls are developer building blocks a user could loop over, not a product bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
